paper.title: Decoding the Language of the Bee
paper.author: Karl von Frisch
paper.folder: Decoding the Language of the Bee 1973
paper.description: 蜜蜂怎样用舞蹈传递食物的位置？从观察行为到设计解码实验。
paper.note: 本站双语导读，非原文全文或逐句翻译。原演讲的正文、图表与实验细节请通过原文入口阅读。
paper.rights: 原演讲受版权保护，本页仅提供本站编写的双语导读与来源链接。

blocks.en: Start with a practical puzzle: a bee finds food, returns to its colony, and other bees reach the same place. How can an experiment distinguish communication from merely following a scent?
blocks.zh: 先从一个实际问题开始：一只蜜蜂找到食物，返回蜂群，其他蜜蜂随后也能到达那个地点。实验怎样才能区分信息交流与单纯追随气味？

blocks.en: Von Frisch connects features of the dance with the direction and distance of a food source. Watching the behavior matters, but changing the feeding conditions makes its meaning testable.
blocks.zh: 冯·弗里施把舞蹈的特征与食物的方向、距离联系起来。观察行为很重要，而改变投喂条件，才能使对舞蹈含义的解释接受检验。

blocks.en: The interesting shift is methodological: an apparently strange movement becomes a system of signals. Read the lecture's figures alongside the experiments, rather than treating the dance as a human sentence.
blocks.zh: 有意思的转变在于研究方法：看似奇怪的动作变成了一套信号系统。阅读时应把图示与实验放在一起看，不必把蜜蜂舞蹈理解成人类语言中的一句话。

blocks.en: Reading question: which observations reveal a pattern, and which interventions support the interpretation of that pattern? This distinction travels well beyond animal behavior.
blocks.zh: 阅读时可以追问：哪些观察发现了规律，哪些干预支持了对规律的解释？这个区别同样适用于动物行为以外的研究。
